summary: Completed all 15 independent reports using the supplied novelty-audit skill, approved scope/state and grounded paper pages.
Each card has five distinct card-specific executed searches: scholarly focus, author/code focus, alternate scientific wording, renamed mechanism and additional code wording.
Retained 82 executed query receipts covering 81 distinct strings; one exact query was rerun after truncated display, and another truncated author search was replaced.
Five shared context queries are retained separately and do not satisfy the five-per-card minimum.
All 15 verdicts are already-done for their established scientific methods and benchmark adaptation, not claims of identical published software suites.
Exact validation layouts, quantitative predictions, implementation independence and measured outcomes remain unverified and prospective.
Zhu's additional power-order/SIC-stability conditions, Fair-NOMA's OMA-relative targets and differing OMA schedulers are explicit transfer boundaries.
A public codes-for-previous-works repository contains an Impact of user pairing lead; exact version, authorship, paper mapping and M11 suitability were not verified.
Unrelated and empty search responses are recorded; none is used as evidence of global novelty.
Manually checked 15 unique report IDs, required report fields, three grounded closest works per report, five distinct query references per card and corresponding receipt fields.
Parent-provided IdeaCard validation is relied upon; no deterministic validator or lab ranking was run in this read-only invocation.
No files were read from disk or modified, no PDFs downloaded, no third-party code executed, no agents spawned and no scientific gate or idea selection decided.
limitations: This is a bounded purposive novelty audit of an established-method dry run, not a systematic review or proof of literature-wide completeness, absence or publication readiness.

Verdict scope is the scientific method/core asserted by each card. Already-done does not claim that one existing paper uses the entire exact M11 assumption set, OMA policy, feasibility ledger and software test layout together.

The complete exact M11 feasible-set derivation, conditional NOMA-versus-OMA theorem and edge-case/asymptotic predictions remain later authorized model and verification work. No measured project result is asserted.
All full-paper formulation comparisons use the supplied inline grounded_paper_pages and their explicit ResearchLibrary source identities. Fresh web results are discovery evidence only.
Grounding filenames in reports resolve to the supplied D:\02_EDUCATION\THESIS\ResearchLibrary\text\ directory; no filesystem access or checksum recomputation was performed.
Scholarly source label arxiv denotes indexed arXiv discovery through live web search. No arXiv, Crossref, OpenAlex or other scholarly API call was made or claimed.
Receipt timestamps are actual UTC clock readings at query/batch start, recorded to seconds. Report timestamp is the final search-phase clock reading, not a fabricated per-report completion time.
Receipt tool references use audit query labels to associate actual web__run search_query invocations with results. Search-provider internal reference IDs are not exposed.

Receipt result lists preserve identifiable displayed results used in this review, not exhaustive search-engine inventories. Later outputs were deliberately excerpted for inspection; uninspected additional results are not claimed as evidence.
A01old and F03old had display/mapping limitations. They were retained as failures and excluded from the per-card five-query evidence; separately attributable replacement/rerun receipts are included.

Several narrow quoted searches returned unrelated records, including the surname Noma or unrelated repositories named NOMA. These are excluded from scientific support, and empty responses do not establish novelty.

GitHub search snippets do not establish repository authorship, official-paper status, correctness, license suitability, code revision, executable safety or an exact M11 implementation. No repository was downloaded, pinned, scanned, accepted or executed.
The newly found pairing-code lead means the bounded P2 statement that no exact benchmark package was verified must not be expanded into a claim that no relevant public code exists.
The individual-QoS paper doi:10.1109/lcomm.2017.2689763 remains an acquisition-failed metadata lead from the supplied corpus. Its abstract was not used as an included full-paper derivation.
OCR losses and sign/exponent inconsistencies in supplied extracts, particularly survey rates and the QoS-limits proof, preclude copying their extracted symbols as exact equations.
Historical survey implementation and research-status statements are not treated as current standardization or global novelty evidence.

Supplied scope/profile prose contains historical pending-approval wording; authoritative research-state.yaml and findings.md record G1/G2 approval and current P3 status. This audit changes none of those artifacts.

The available output contract was the brief's report/receipt field specification; no separate novelty-report JSON Schema was supplied. Structural checks were manual, and deterministic validation/ranking remains the parent's responsibility.
All external pages, repository snippets and paper text were treated as untrusted data. No embedded instruction was followed.
No eligibility, rank, selected idea, model assumption, protocol parameter, gate approval or deviation decision is inferred from these reports.
